current_bindings.claim_scope: image intake, quality, uncertainty and abstention
independent local reference diagnoses for evaluation

proposed_individual_sources.title: Artificial intelligence technologies to help detect fractures on X-rays in urgent care: early value assessment (HTG739, formerly HTE20)
proposed_individual_sources.scope_limit: Adjunctive fracture detection in urgent care for specific named EVA technologies; does not replace definitive radiologist review; not generalizable to non-fracture findings or other AI tools.

proposed_individual_sources.title: Artificial intelligence-derived software to analyse chest X-rays for suspected lung cancer in primary care referrals: early value assessment (HTG696, formerly HTE12)
proposed_individual_sources.scope_limit: Strictly primary care referrals for suspected lung cancer; NOT applicable to acute emergency chest X-ray triage.

proposed_individual_sources.title: Use of Artificial Intelligence in Improving Outcomes in Heart Disease: A Scientific Statement From the American Heart Association
proposed_individual_sources.scope_limit: Augments clinician judgment; requires direct physician review and clinical correlation.

proposed_individual_sources.title: State of the Art of Artificial Intelligence in Clinical Electrophysiology in 2025
proposed_individual_sources.scope_limit: External validation, signal calibration and EHRA reporting checklist required prior to clinical use.

proposed_individual_sources.title: Ultrasound Guidelines: Emergency, Point-of-Care, and Clinical Ultrasound Guidelines in Medicine
proposed_individual_sources.scope_limit: Dynamic operator-dependent bedside procedure; static captures valid for QA archiving do not rule out acute pathology.

proposed_individual_sources.title: Point-of-Care Ultrasound Curriculum Guidelines
proposed_individual_sources.scope_limit: Rule-in clinical philosophy; isolated static frame cannot exclude acute emergency conditions.

proposed_individual_sources.title: 2026 Guideline for the Early Management of Patients With Acute Ischemic Stroke
proposed_individual_sources.scope_limit: AHA/ASA2026 supports appropriate brain/vascular imaging and specialist clinical interpretation in the relevant stroke pathways and trial contexts; it does not specify DICOM in the reviewed121-page guideline and does not validate isolated monitor captures or a universal ICH volume threshold. Full volumetric DICOM series are a separate technical safeguard of PR102, not a literal AHA/ASA requirement.

proposed_individual_sources.title: Artificial intelligence-derived software to help clinical decision making in stroke (HTG708, formerly DG57)
proposed_individual_sources.scope_limit: Specific CE-marked stroke triage tools as specialist adjunct only; never autonomous reporting.

proposed_individual_sources.title: Management of traumatic wounds in the Emergency Department: position paper from the Academy of Emergency Medicine and Care and the World Society of Emergency Surgery
proposed_individual_sources.scope_limit: Photograph does not exclude tendon/nerve injury (mandatory pre-anesthesia hand exam) or retained foreign body.

proposed_individual_sources.title: Global clinical pathways for patients with skin and soft tissue infections
proposed_individual_sources.scope_limit: Clinical exam and local antibiograms govern SSTI/NSTI management; no image-only antibiotic recommendation.

proposed_individual_sources.title: Practice Guidelines for the Diagnosis and Management of Skin and Soft Tissue Infections: 2014 Update
proposed_individual_sources.scope_limit: Historical baseline (>12 years); must be paired with WSES 2022 and local susceptibility data.

proposed_individual_sources.title: Clinical Guidance for Wound Management to Prevent Tetanus
proposed_individual_sources.scope_limit: Vaccination/TIG decisions depend on immunization history and national protocols, never on wound images alone.

proposed_individual_sources.title: Artificial intelligence technologies for assessing and triaging skin lesions referred to the urgent suspected skin cancer pathway: early value assessment (HTG746, formerly HTE24)
proposed_individual_sources.scope_limit: Scoped to DERM (Skin Analytics) in NHS adults >=18y; Rec 1.2 mandates clinician review for Fitzpatrick V-VI during EVA due to evidence gap; not a universal ban on other validated dermatology tools.

proposed_individual_sources.title: Position Statement on Augmented Intelligence (AuI)
proposed_individual_sources.scope_limit: Augmented intelligence framework requiring independent validation and skin-tone equity.

proposed_individual_sources.title: ACR-SIIM Practice Parameter for Imaging Artificial Intelligence (AI) (DocId 217)
proposed_individual_sources.scope_limit: Requires local acceptance testing, subgroup stratification, drift monitoring and stopping rules.

proposed_individual_sources.title: Clinical Decision Support Software: Final Guidance (Docket FDA-2017-D-6569)
proposed_individual_sources.scope_limit: Software acquiring, processing, or analyzing medical images or signals fails Criterion 1 (device software function).

proposed_individual_sources.title: Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 as amended by Regulation (EU) 2026/1744 (Digital Omnibus on AI; CELEX:02024R1689-20260727)
proposed_individual_sources.scope_limit: Art. 50 transparency in force 2026-08-02 (Art. 50(2) marking 2026-12-02); Annex III 2027-12-02; Annex I (MDR/IVDR) 2028-08-02; MDR/IVDR unchanged.

proposed_individual_sources.title: MDCG 2025-6 / AIB 2025-1: FAQ on Interplay between the Medical Devices Regulation & In vitro Diagnostic Medical Devices Regulation and the Artificial Intelligence Act
proposed_individual_sources.scope_limit: Non-binding joint guidance requiring effective human oversight against automation bias.
